name: Kamekichi
source:
"A cockatoo and the MANKAI Company mascot. Kamekichi was named by the Director's father Yukio and is able speak well enough to act on stage. Kamekichi is an intelligent parrot with a pretty foul mouth and bad habits. He likes to insult people and often says what he wants without mercy, especially towards Isuke Matsukawa."

[From the [url=https://yaycupcake.com/a3/index.php?title=Other_Characters#tab=MANKAI_Company_and_Affiliates]A3! Wiki[/url]]
